summary: Iteration-3 review round: backend + frontend smoke. Seeded credentials confirmed restored on backend startup (admin/owner/marshal/driver all return must_change=true; passenger Lizwi returns must_change=false). All 22 backend tests pass (18 in test_new_features.py + 4 new in test_marshal_driver_flow.py). Covered: login regression + friendly 401, validation errors on /admin/owners, /admin/marshals, /owner/taxis, public+passenger taxi lookup exposing driver_name and driver_contact (+27), marshal short-route add+depart with revenue 26*15=390, long-distance requires long_distance_passengers, owner revenue shape (total_revenue, per_taxi, operations), marshal ADD rank-scope + double-queue rejection, driver join via marshal QR token (correct rank succeeds, wrong rank rejected). Frontend smoke: landing/signin/passenger-dashboard/change-secret pages ALL show the 'EST 2026 · Developed by PMP Solutions' footer; passenger login works end-to-end; owner login correctly redirects to /change-secret (must_change enforced). Owner RandIcon + expandable taxi rows and Driver 'Scan rank QR to join' + 'Enter code manually' fallback verified by source-code inspection (interactive dashboards are gated by the must_change screen, which per test guidance we did not bypass).
critical_code_review_comments: test_marshal_driver_flow tests must be run with -n 0 (serial) because they mutate the same taxi (MT 004 GP) queue state as test_new_features::TestMarshalDepart. With the pytest.ini default '-n 2 --dist loadscope' they interleave and race on shared preview backend. Consider using unique taxi registrations or a per-test seed/rollback fixture in future backend tests.

seed.py restore-on-startup verified working: after backend restart admin/owner/marshal/driver all report must_change=true and login with documented PINs succeeds. Passenger Lizwi has must_change=false as expected.
Owner dashboard revenue stat uses a custom RandIcon component and formats amounts as R{amount}; expandable rows render Trips/Revenue/recent trips correctly (OwnerDashboard.jsx lines 81, 141-155).

Driver dashboard exposes both camera scan (data-testid='driver-scan-btn') and manual entry toggle (data-testid='manual-toggle'), matching the requirement. QrScanner is dialog-gated, so headless-browser camera limitations do not affect the manual-entry fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (footers on 4 routes verified; passenger login OK; owner must_change redirect OK)

rca of the issue: No functional bugs found in this round. Only observation: pytest.ini enables xdist parallel by default (-n 2 --dist loadscope), which caused a shared-taxi-state race between test_new_features.TestMarshalDepart and test_marshal_driver_flow when both files ran together. Mitigated by running with -n 0; not a product bug.
